name: PersonalMcpGateway

dataInventory.reason: The five approved diagnostics tools read live Windows process, module, and fleet state. They are available only while the local Gateway is running, including through its authenticated tunnel.
A future cloud control plane may retain only the last sanitized observation with observedAt, expiry, stale, and offline semantics; it is never authoritative live state.
A future cloud control plane may retain bounded sanitized audit records, but no diagnostics payload, runtime revision, secret, device identifier, or support bundle.

knownGaps: Windows shutdown stops the Gateway and no new heartbeat, runtime revision, module health, or fleet state may be generated while it is off.
Any future cloud projection is capped at last-heartbeat and sanitized audit records and must report stale/offline rather than live state.
